availability.availability: rank space all (a, b, c): available, compatibility scores computed for 12/12 members and normalizable; rank space a_only (a): unavailable: compatibility scores computed for 12/12 members, but the policy cannot be normalized (cell 0: every selected-window score is zero (sum 0.0) in rank space 'a_only'); the computed zero scores remain valid diagnostics

a_only.reason: component: cell 0: every selected-window score is zero (sum 0.0) in rank space 'a_only'; the selection is refused rather than dropping the cell or redistributing its mass (no uniform fallback, no floor).

prob_photo_bleach.reason: empirically anchored declared per-dye bleaching probability over the fixed 100-frame reference interval: the measured whole-recording fluorescence decline of the sixty MET-FAB recordings over 20 s (0.054 to 0.057 per 100-frame interval, record ..._20S_50FPS_Direct_Fluorescence_Loss_Experiment_RAW), rounded as a working value and selected on 2026-10-01 (DETECTOR_WORKFLOW.md sec. 7.6). The estimator's own coordinate (median 0.093, MAP 0.148) is not retained: it does not recover the parameter on synthetic videos (r 0.06). Assumptions: ideal independent dyes of stationary mean brightness; the decline is not single-exponential, emitters leaving the field and label exchange are not separable from bleaching.

lambda_rate.reason: declared working value, rounded from the adopted Fab detector estimator C128V42A (median 8.096 per second over the 600 per-window posterior medians, MAP 8.204, SGM 7.884; window spread 0.07 dex); the parameter is only partially recovered on synthetic videos (MAE 0.217 dex, r 0.49), so its per-window SGM coordinates are not retained and its digits are not kept; the localization-autocorrelation anchor about 5 (DETECTOR_WORKFLOW.md sec. 6.5) is 0.21 dex below and nothing on the recordings decides between them. Same value and basis as the SEL selection_user record (sec. 7.6).
